name: hcapp_sendEventMessage
description: Sends a run (event) chat message. Inserts the HC.EventMessage row (HC.trgCreateSeqNum assigns MessageSequenceCount), upserts HC.EventMessageBadgeCounts so the sender never sees their own message as unread, then returns the inserted message (rowset 0) and two API-only push audiences: visible (rowset 1) and silent/data-only (rowset 2). Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 61, @param NULL — a STANDARD device-secret token; the HC5 compound DeviceSecret+eventId token is gone). Permission gate: the sender must hold a live HasherKennelMap row for the run's kennel OR any HasherEventMap row for the run (errorCode 1263, errorType 3 otherwise). @messageReleasabilityFlags bitmask: 0x0001 mismanagement, 0x0002 members, 0x0004 followers, 0x0008 RSVPs (RsvpState >= 2), 0x0010 hares, 0x0020 everyone; at least one bit required. Push audience (rewritten 2026-09-17 and 2026-10-02, E9.F1.S27): hashers of the kennel with an effective bell (event override, else kennel) of 1/3/4 on live devices signed in within 180 days who have not blocked the sender and match the releasability bits; HC6.RunChatTie decides whether a kennel-bell-only hasher BUZZES (run is personally theirs — RSVP Yes / attended / posted — or they are GM/On-Sec) or gets a SILENT push (any run of a kennel they belong to or follow); a bell set on the run itself always wins; 4 'on before the run' buzzes only inside ±6 h of the start. Rowset 0's MessageContent is HC6.ChatMessagePreview (the push body). Since 2026-10-13 a resend of an already-stored @messageId by the same sender in the same thread is idempotent: nothing is written, rowset 0 returns the stored message and the push rowsets are empty, so nobody is notified twice (a resend after a lost reply used to hit PK_EventMessage and report a delivered message as unsent). The post-commit part (rowset 0 and the push rowsets) is in its own TRY whose CATCH logs 'Push audience failed in sendEventMessage' and swallows, as sendRoomMessage; only a failure of the write returns the 9999 error. Since 2026-10-13 its MERGE into HC.EventMessageBadgeCounts holds HOLDLOCK: the table has no unique key on (UserId, EventId, KennelId, ThreadId, MessageType), and two concurrent MERGEs could each insert a row.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Default NULL (ValidateAppAuth then fails gracefully).

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token, STANDARD (device secret, @param NULL). Validated by HC6.ValidateAppAuth with spNumber 61. Default NULL.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Internal event UUID. Required; NULL → 1261. Changed from NVARCHAR(250) in HC5 — breaking change. An unknown id is not detected as such: the kennel lookup yields NULL and the sender is refused with 1263 'Not authorised'.

parameters.name: messageId
parameters.description: Client-generated message UUID. Required; NULL → 1261. A duplicate id is a PK violation caught by the CATCH (9999) — the insert is not idempotent.

parameters.name: messageTitle
parameters.description: Optional title. NULL → Event.EventName via COALESCE before insert.

parameters.name: messageContent
parameters.description: Message body (text, a chat-photos blob URL, or a map link by @messageKind). Required — LEN() = 0 or NULL → 1261. More than 4,000 UTF-16 code units (the column width since 2026-09-23) is refused with 1264, errorType 2; the parameter is MAX so it is refused rather than silently truncated.

parameters.name: messageReleasabilityFlags
parameters.description: Push-audience bitmask; at least one bit in 0x003F must be set, NULL or 0 → 1261. 0x0001 mismanagement, 0x0002 members (MembershipExpirationDate in the future), 0x0004 followers, 0x0008 RSVPs (HasherEventMap.RsvpState >= 2), 0x0010 hares, 0x0020 everyone.

parameters.name: messageKind
parameters.description: 0 text (default), 1 photo (MessageContent = blob URL in chat-photos), 2 location (MessageContent = Google Maps search URL). NULL → 0. Validated by HC6.ChatMessageKindError; invalid → 1265, errorType 2. Added 2026-09-29 (E9.F1.S11/S12).

parameters.name: replyToMessageId
parameters.description: The message this one quotes (E9.F1.S21). Kept only when it is a message of THIS run (EventId match); otherwise silently cleared and the message sends without a quote.

rowsets.name: ErrorResult
rowsets.description: Returned alone, then RETURN, on: auth failure (codes/types from ValidateAppAuth); 1261 messageId NULL / eventId NULL / content empty / releasability missing or zero (errorType 12 — not the HC6 standard 2); 1264 content over 4,000 (2); 1265 bad message kind (2); 1263 sender not a kennel member/follower nor on the run (3); 9999 unhandled error from the CATCH (5). Because the TRY spans past the COMMIT (see code smells), 9999 can also follow an already-committed insert.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: Unique ID of the HC.ErrorLog entry.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: From ValidateAppAuth on auth failure; 12 for 1261; 2 for 1264/1265; 3 for 1263; 5 for 9999.

columns.name: errorTitle
columns.description: Short error title for display.

columns.name: errorUserMessage
columns.description: User-facing error message.

columns.name: errorProc
columns.description: SP name via OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID).

rowsets.name: InsertedMessage
rowsets.description: On success: the just-inserted message, one row, for the sender's optimistic UI and the API's push body.

columns.name: MessageId
columns.description: EventMessage.id — the client-supplied messageId.

columns.name: EventId
columns.description: EventMessage.EventId. UNIQUEIDENTIFIER (was NVARCHAR in HC5) — breaking change.

columns.name: PublicEventId
columns.description: EventMessage.PublicEventId — public-facing event UUID.

columns.name: UserId
columns.description: Hasher.PublicHasherId of the sender (not the internal Hasher.id).

columns.name: UserDisplayName
columns.description: Hasher.DisplayName — persisted computed column (hash name or real name per preference).

columns.name: UserPhoto
columns.description: Hasher.Photo — URL of the sender's profile photo.

columns.name: MessageTitle
columns.description: DisplayName + ' - ' + EventMessage.MessageTitle (the EventName default when the caller passed NULL).

columns.name: MessageContent
columns.description: HC6.ChatMessagePreview(MessageKind, MessageContent): the text, or a photo/location placeholder. The API uses it as the push body — NOT the raw URL for a photo or location.

columns.name: MessageKind
columns.description: 0 text, 1 photo, 2 location.

columns.name: MessageReleasabilityFlags
columns.description: EventMessage.MessageReleasabilityFlags. Column name corrected from the HC5 typo 'MessageRelesabilityFlags' — breaking change for any caller reading it by name.

columns.name: EventChatMessageCount
columns.description: Always 0 — hardcoded. Obsolete field retained for client compatibility.

columns.name: MessageType
columns.description: EventMessage.MessageType — 0 for a run thread (INT in the table, not NVARCHAR as the HC5 contract said).

rowsets.name: VisiblePushRecipients
rowsets.description: On success, API-only: one row per distinct FCM token with Buzz = 1 — effective bell 1, or 4 inside ±6 h of the run start, AND (the bell is set on the run itself, or HC6.RunChatTie says the run is personally theirs, or they are the kennel's GM/On-Sec). Audience base: HasherKennelMap rows for the run's kennel (not removed, hasher not removed), device live with a token and LastLogin within 180 days, not blocking the sender (HasherFriendMap.Ignore), effective bell in (1,3,4), and matching the releasability bits. The sender's own devices are included on purpose (the echo drives the delivered tick). May be empty.

columns.name: UserId
columns.description: HasherKennelMap.UserId — internal Hasher.id (not PublicHasherId).

columns.name: FcmToken
columns.description: Device.FcmToken — only non-null tokens are returned.

columns.name: BadgeTotal
columns.description: The recipient's unread chat total for the app icon (HC6.UserUnreadChatTotal); the API puts it in aps.badge / notification_count / data.BadgeTotal. Added 2026-09-28. NULL when no device with that token is on a build >= HC6.MinBuildForIconBadge() (older apps never lower the icon).

rowsets.name: SilentPushRecipients
rowsets.description: On success, API-only: tokens with Buzz = 0 and Silent = 1 — a data-only push so the badge moves without a notification: bell 3 (muted), bell 4 outside the window, or a kennel-bell-only hasher whose tie to the run is just the kennel (member or follower). A token that already appears in rowset 1 (another account on the same phone) is excluded via NOT EXISTS. May be empty.

columns.name: UserId
columns.description: HasherKennelMap.UserId.

columns.name: FcmToken
columns.description: Device.FcmToken — only non-null tokens are returned.

columns.name: BadgeTotal
columns.description: As rowset 1.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.EventMessage — fires HC.trgCreateSeqNum (assigns MessageSequenceCount across the run's messages) and HC.trgEventMessageActivityCount → HC6.nonApi_refreshEventActivity (keeps HC.Event's run-card chat count current, E5.F7.S1).
MERGE HC.EventMessageBadgeCounts (UserId, EventId) — the sender's last-read position moves to the new MessageSequenceCount.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on every refused path and in the CATCH (HcVersion from HC6.DeviceHcVersion).

Reads HC.HasherFriendMap (block check), HC6.RunChatTie, HC6.UserUnreadChatTotal, HC6.MinBuildForIconBadge for the audience; the API shim fans out FCM pushes from rowsets 1 and 2 — nothing is queued in the database.

codeSmells.detail: @timeLimitHours is declared as SMALLINT = 6 at line 179 with no configuration source. Should be driven by a kennel-level or system-level setting rather than a hardcoded literal.

codeSmells.issue: Validation errorType 12 instead of the HC6 standard 2
codeSmells.detail: Lines 101, 111 and 123 set errorType 12 for the three 1261 refusals, while the later 1264/1265 checks (lines 141, 164) use 2. Clients that branch on errorType 2 for validation miss the 1261 cases.

codeSmells.issue: Any HasherEventMap row counts as 'attending' for the posting gate
codeSmells.detail: Line 202 admits the sender on the bare existence of a HasherEventMap row. A neutral row (AttendenceState 0 / RsvpState 0) is created by hcapp_setChatPin and by RSVP 'No', so a hasher who declined the run or merely pinned its chat is admitted. Consistent with the product rule that anyone can open any run's chat, but the error text ('must be ... attending this run') overstates the gate.
Line 274 hardcodes 0. The HC5 contract notes it was obsolete as of 2.1.3. Retained for client compatibility but should be removed when clients no longer read it.

codeSmells.issue: Run start computed from raw EventStartDatetime
codeSmells.detail: Line 185 derives UTC from CAST(EventStartDatetime AS DATETIME) AT TIME ZONE tz — correct (the CAST drops the spurious +00:00 the column carries on ~67 % of rows) but HC.Event.EventStartDateTimeGmt already holds the instant (/hc-event-datetimes). Using it would drop the HC.City and DomainValues.Timezone joins.

codeSmells.issue: MessageSequenceCount read back after INSERT relies on trigger timing
codeSmells.detail: Line 238 reads MessageSequenceCount immediately after the INSERT, relying on HC.trgCreateSeqNum (AFTER INSERT) having updated the row. AFTER triggers fire before control returns, so this is correct SQL Server behaviour, but it is a subtle dependency worth documenting.

breakingChanges: @eventId type changed from NVARCHAR(250) to UNIQUEIDENTIFIER — callers must pass a typed UUID, not a string
Access token is a standard device-secret token (@param NULL), not the HC5 compound DeviceSecret + eventId token
InsertedMessage rowset: EventId column type changed from NVARCHAR to UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
InsertedMessage rowset: column renamed from 'MessageRelesabilityFlags' (HC5 typo) to 'MessageReleasabilityFlags' — any caller reading this column by name must be updated
Error path now uses early RETURN after each validation failure — at most one error rowset is emitted (HC5 could emit multiple error rowsets without RETURN)
2026-09-29 (E9.F1.S11-S14): additive — @messageKind, MessageKind column, MessageContent is now the preview; see docs/chat_photos_location_delete_plan.md

2026-09-17 / 2026-10-02: push audience narrowed — a bell of 0 (never chosen) no longer receives anything; kennel-bell-only hashers buzz only for runs HC6.RunChatTie calls theirs (E9.F1.S27). Rowset shapes unchanged.
